title: A Bridge for the Compass
author: Felix Voss
blurb: Mirabel Montrose, a pearl diver's child indentured to a trading company, keeps a low profile and busy hands. Then a stranger arrives carrying unmistakable handwriting from a supposed corpse — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must keep a promise made in peacetime to someone now declared enemy, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
